[EN] Many researchers were sent to Stone Pillar Relics to study the area, but they have all been chased away by the Kulkari positioned there.

It is urgent that we secure the grounds there before the statue research can begin. If you could eliminate the {@LinkCreature:21#9#Crag Stalker ragers} and {@LinkCreature:21#10#Crag Stalker crushers} from the area, it would help us get started on the research sooner.
[ES] Muchos investigadores fueron enviados aStone Pillar Relics para estudiar la zona, pero todos han sido ahuyentados por los kulkari apostados allí.

Es urgente que aseguremos el terreno antes de que pueda comenzar la investigación de las estatuas. Si pudieras eliminar a los {@LinkCreature:21#9#Crag Stalker ragers} y {@LinkCreature:21#10#Crag Stalker crushers} de la zona, nos ayudarías a empezar la investigación antes.

[EN] Thank you. We can finally concentrate on our research.
[ES] Gracias. Por fin podemos concentrarnos en nuestra investigación.
